wide_height_fit: Full-width8x8 fit had9.5-10.3mm P95 residual and produced a visible local crease. Rejected before publication. The front corner fit is restricted to its actual transverse domain with more transverse controls.
prototype_timing: A preview was started before the private manifest was complete; that failed preview was rerun after the native bake finished.
symmetry: Initial CDT centre-crossing triangles rejected by unchanged native triangle-count assertion; source symmetry is enforced before export.
separate_top_sheet: The isolated height-chart prototype left a visible diagonal transition. Rejected before publication. The accepted approach extends the existing continuous-side chart through the nose and gates its normals by actual geometric projection, preserving one coherent side/front chart.
bonnet_gap: The first extended-side-chart candidate reduced front normal-contour ripple by about66-72%, but moved the body bank away from the bonnet corner. Rejected before publication; the new source preserves/fades at the actual bonnet boundary.
paired_crown_survey: A fixed-X crown survey compared different material stations after the explicit lateral taper and exceeded35mm at one outer sample. Paired transverse sampling now follows the authorized18mm maximum inset; the original35mm displacement bound remains unchanged. Fixed-X measurements are retained separately.
concurrent_livery_inputs: Native budget17/0 and panel172/0 assertions passed, but the broad source fence rejected concurrent livery_graphics/livery shader edits. Exact rejected receipts are retained; qualifying runs are repeated on settled inputs.
